On Solomon instances, equity improves with a measurable cost trade-off
Core finding
HERO improves workload balance, while dedicated solvers remain stronger cost references.
Retrieval effect
ALNS+HNSW reaches similar cost to cost-only ALNS with lower reported time.
Equity effect
HERO reports lower CV and Gini, alongside a higher Jain’s index than cost-only ALNS.
The trade-off
The equity gain comes with higher total cost; OR-Tools and PyVRP mark the lower-cost boundary.
